Legal

Cookie Policy

Effective date: 6 September 2026

1. Scope

This policy covers cookies and similar technologies on the enterlabs website and review websites linking to this policy. The authenticated platform is a separate service with its own browser-storage requirements.

2. The public website

This public website does not currently set analytics cookies and does not load an analytics collector or tracking pixel. Typography is served from the site's own servers. Server logs and the website's hosting provider may still contain technical information about your visit, as described in our Privacy Policy.

3. External services

The enquiry form on this website is submitted through the website's hosting provider. Email links open your chosen email application.

Cookies or similar technologies used by external services you choose to visit are subject to the relevant provider's notices and your browser settings. This policy does not represent external services as cookie-free.

4. Your controls

You can review, block or delete cookies using your browser settings. Restrictions may affect hosting or external services you choose to visit.

5. The authenticated platform

The Platform uses browser storage for authentication, preferences and workflow state. Platform use is governed by the applicable client agreement; the statement about the public website above does not apply to the authenticated Platform.
